# Dates and times

EasyLanguage has two date encodings. An EL date is a number like 1240102 (years since 1900, then month and day: 2 January 2024); an EL time is HHMM, or HHMMSS for the `_s` forms. A DateTime value counts days, with the time of day as the fraction.

[Back to the keyword reference index](README.md)

### CurrentDate

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | no | runs |

Today's date as an EL date. In a PowerBridge backtest it follows the bar being evaluated, so results do not depend on when you run them.

```easylanguage
Vars: D(0);
D = CurrentDate;
```
